description: Erection of a single storey rear extension following the demolition of an exisiting extension and outrigger to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Drawings 001, 002, 003, 010, 050, 110(A), - Fire Safety Statement - Received 12/07/2023, 150(A)- Received 18/08/2023, 110 (B)- Received 11/09/2023].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
